bg.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest background (MarsUI Surface/primary_low_em_alpha: brand-500 at 20% light / 56% dark; the master defines no indeterminate hover, so every state keeps the tint).

fg.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest dash (Figma binds Text/primary_med_em brand-500, which measures 2.7:1 against the 56% tint in dark; one em step up keeps the 3:1 non-text law in both schemes — gate-driven compliant alternative).

border.$description: color used by the checkbox component for indeterminate rest border (Figma draws no border on the 20% tint, but the tint alone measures ~1.3:1 against light pages; the opaque brand ring keeps the WCAG 1.4.11 3:1 control boundary — gate-driven declared deviation, same law that pinned ki.outline.control).
